```python
from functools import partial
playlist_totals = [
    (playlist['title'], playlist['playlist_id'], len(playlist['song_ids']), sum(song['duration'] for song in apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist['playlist_id'], access_token=spotify_access_token)['songs']))
    for playlist in library_playlists
]
playlist_totals_seconds = [(title, song_count, duration) for title, playlist_id, song_count, duration in playlist_totals if duration >= 5100]
print(playlist_totals_seconds)
```
